newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Honduras police rescue kidnapped beer executive.
newsitem.headline: Honduras police rescue kidnapped beer executive.

text.p: A kidnapped Honduran beer executive was freed unharmed on Friday during a three-hour siege by a special counterinsurgency force in which one officer was killed, police said.
The executive said he was psychologically tortured by six kidnappers during his week-long capture. "They tortured me psychologically and threatened to kill me," Villatoro, 32, told reporters.
"Mr Guillermo Villatora was freed by combined forces of the police near the city of Tela," police spokesman Capt. Danilo Orellana told reporters.
Police captured five alleged kidnappers. A sixth had been captured Thursday in the port city of Tela, about 110 miles (180 km) north of the capital, Tegucigalpa.

Earlier on Friday, police Lt. Gaspar Osorio died from several shots to the chest during a daring but failed attempt to free Villatoro, treasurer of the brewing company Cerveceria Hondurena. After the initial rescue attempt, police sent 40 sharpshooters to the scene.
Villatoro was kidnapped on Saturday from a northern Honduras ranch. His kidnappers had demanded a $400,000 ransom. The rescue took place in the Lancetilla area, near Tela.
